turns.text: Hi, I need to change my flight, add a bag, fix my name spelling, and get a receipt. Quick please.
Happy to help. First, I need your booking code and last name.
Thanks, Mr. Malik, I have your booking. I'll start with the change. Which flight and day do you want?
Friday, the afternoon one, the 14:30 to London.
That's SK212 at 14:30, at 455 dollars against your 410, so you'd pay a 45 dollar fare difference plus a 75 dollar change fee, 120 total. Shall I book it?
Yes, book it. Now the bag, the name, and the receipt?
Done, you're on SK212 Friday at 14:30. I'm sorry, I can't add bags, correct names or send receipts on this line, and I don't want to guess at those. I can arrange a supervisor callback for them.
Fine, do the callback, for all three. I'm in a rush.
I've requested it for the bag, the name spelling and the receipt. Is the number on the booking the right one?
You're welcome. To sum up, I moved you to SK212 on Friday at 14:30 for 120 dollars, and requested a supervisor callback for the other items.
